# RealEstate-Analytics.ai

> CCIM-grade, deterministic real estate deal analysis for investors, agents, lenders, and financial planners. Free browser-based calculators plus a Pro plan with deal lead sourcing, comps, and full deal reviews. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Tools
- [Quick Deal Analyzer](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/#quick-analyzer): Multi-metric rental deal evaluator — cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, IRR, equity multiple, 10-year projections, PDF report.
- [Cap Rate Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/cap-rate-calculator): NOI divided by purchase price, with deal grading and 2026 benchmarks.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/dscr-calculator): Debt service coverage ratio and lender qualification.
- [Break-Even Occupancy Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/breakeven): Occupancy and rent needed to cover operating expenses and debt service.
- [IRR Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/irr-calculator): Internal rate of return and equity multiple over a hold period.
- [Cash-on-Cash Calculator](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/cash-on-cash-calculator): Annual levered yield on invested equity.
- [Tenant Credit Analysis](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/tenant-credit): Rent-to-income and DTI screening for applicants.
- [Lease Type Analyzer](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/tools/lease-type): NNN vs. gross vs. modified gross.
- [Property IQ Deal Analyzer (Pro)](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/pricing): Pro deal analyzer with MLS, OM and T-12 PDF import, market intelligence, dual comps, Deal Radar prospecting and PDF reports. Every number comes from fixed CCIM-grade formulas.

## Guides
- [What Is a Good Cap Rate in 2026?](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/what-is-a-good-cap-rate-2026)
- [How to Analyze a Multifamily Deal](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/how-to-analyze-multifamily-deal)
- [Is ChatGPT Accurate for Real Estate Deal Analysis?](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/is-chatgpt-accurate-for-real-estate-deal-analysis): Why chatbots are unreliable calculators; worked 4-plex example with deterministic math.
- [California Notice of Default to Auction Timeline](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/california-notice-of-default-to-auction-timeline): Earliest trustee's sale is 3 months + 20 days after the NOD is recorded (Civ. Code §2924, §2924f); includes a date calculator.
- [ZIP Code Market Analysis for Real Estate Investors](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/zipcode-market-analysis): Vacancy, rent trends and data sources for evaluating a ZIP code before you buy.
- [Load Your OM](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/load-your-om): AI extracts deal data from an offering memorandum PDF into a deterministic deal analyzer.
- [Load Your T-12](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/load-t12): AI extracts actual NOI from trailing 12-month income statements (AppFolio, Buildium, Yardi, QuickBooks PDFs), then deterministic math checks the deal.
- [Best AI Underwriting Tools for Real Estate in 2026](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/best-ai-underwriting-tools-2026): Hypha, Keyway, Smart Capital Center, Cash Flow Portal, Built, V7, redIQ and Property IQ compared by audience, documents read and where the math runs.
- [Deterministic vs AI Underwriting](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/deterministic-vs-ai-underwriting): Why AI should extract and explain while fixed formulas do the deal math.
- [How to Stress-Test DSCR](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/dscr-stress-test): Worked 6-unit example; DSCR falls from 1.29 to 0.82 when rents, vacancy, expenses and rate all worsen.
- [Rent Roll Analysis](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/blog/rent-roll-analysis): Fields to extract, red flags, and reconciling a rent roll with the T-12.

## Company
- [AI Integrations](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/integrations): One MCP server brings the deterministic engine into Claude, ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot; listed on the official MCP Registry as ai.realestate-analytics/mcp.
- [Partners & Advertising](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/partners): Sponsored placements, integrations and referral partnerships.

## Pricing
- [Free](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/pricing): Interactive calculators and PDF deal reports, no signup.
- [Pro — $45/month](https://www.realestate-analytics.ai/pricing): Property IQ Deal Analyzer, Deal lead sourcing, comps, and CCIM-grade full deal reviews.
